summary: This note describes Novgorod Governorate, an administrative division (guberniya) of the Russian Empire and later the Russian SFSR. It existed in two periods, 1727 to 1776 and 1796 to 1927, with its administrative center in the city of Novgorod. The governorate lay in the northwest of the European part of the Russian Empire.
one_line: Novgorod Governorate was a Russian imperial and Soviet-era administrative division centered on Novgorod, existing 1727–1776 and 1796–1927.
key_facts: Novgorod Governorate was an administrative division called a guberniya.
Novgorod Governorate was a division of the Russian Empire and the Russian SFSR.
Novgorod Governorate existed again from 1796 to 1927.
The administrative center of Novgorod Governorate was in the city of Novgorod.
Novgorod Governorate was located in the northwest of the European part of the Russian Empire.
The Russian name of Novgorod Governorate is "Novgorodskaya guberniya", meaning Government of Novgorod.
